usedFor: Shopify holds the storefront and orders, and Autopilot holds clients and jobs for a home service business. An “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify can create a lead with “Create Client” in Autopilot, so a shopper who stalled lands in the CRM.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Client” in Autopilot
bestTemplate.why: The abandoned checkout has the shopper's email or phone, which is what a new client or lead record needs. “Create Client” saves contact details and tags, so someone can call back.

watchOut: “Update Client” in Autopilot requires a client ID and leaves empty fields unchanged, so use “Create Client” first and keep that ID before you try updates.
